title: Textarea
description: Multi-line field with vertical-only resize, a monospace variant, and content sizing where supported

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label linked to the native textarea. An instance ID is generated unless id is supplied.

props.name: help
props.description: Helper content included in the textarea accessible description.

props.name: error
props.description: Error content included in the accessible description and invalid state; false, null and undefined omit it.

props.name: count
props.description: Caller-supplied count display beside the helper. The component does not calculate a character count.

props.name: monospace
props.description: Use the code font treatment; defaults to false.

props.name: autoSize
props.description: Use native content-based field sizing where supported; defaults to false. Native fallback resizing remains available.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes on the field wrapper. className, ref and native textarea props target the textarea itself.
